title: Does the IRS use AI to pick audits? What GAO says
label: AI in tax

link.label: AI in accounting and tax 2026 guide (MFA)

hook.sub: Yes, to help pick some audits.

beats.text: AI helps the IRS *choose* some audits

items.t: Picking a sample of returns to audit
Keep records for what you deduct
Keep books that match your bank

cta.sub: We'll DM you our AI in accounting guide.

captions.instagram:
Yes, the IRS uses AI. Here's what the government's own watchdog says it's used for.

✔️ GAO (report GAO-24-106449, 2024): AI models help the IRS select a sample of returns to audit.
✔️ The IRS also uses AI, along with manual review, to pick some tax credit claims (like the earned income credit) for audit, and AI models to help prioritize partnership returns.
✔️ What you control: report all income (1099 or not), keep records for what you deduct, and keep books that match your bank.

Our AI in accounting guide covers how AI is changing tax work on both sides.

sources.fact: GAO WatchBlog (June 6, 2024) on GAO-24-106449: AI models are already used to help select a representative sample of returns to audit; IRS uses manual processes and AI to pick claims for credits such as the EITC for audit; IRS uses two AI models to help prioritize partnership returns for audit; read 2026-10-30
All income is taxable unless the law says otherwise, even without a Form 1099-K (Form 1099-K FAQs, page updated 03-Apr-2026; read 2026-10-24, within 30 days)

Supporting documents for expenses: canceled checks/proof of payment, cash register receipts, account statements, credit card receipts and statements, invoices; they should show payee, amount, proof of payment, date and a description showing business purpose; requirements for paper records also apply to electronic records (page updated 03-Aug-2026); read 2026-10-30
